first_visit: A customer! Gerald, a real one! Come in. Mind the floor, it bites.
I'm Bodge. This is my stall. That's my caravan. The wheels are somebody else's now.
Everything here's for sale except the parrot, and I haven't got a parrot. Have a look!
enter: You came back! With all your bits, too. I count them every time.
Oh good, it's you. I was arguing with the shelf and losing.
Shake the sand off. Or don't. This sand's been here longer than I have.
Don't touch the blue tin. Touch anything else. The blue tin knows what it did.
I dreamt you'd come in today. In the dream you were a moth. Close enough.
Welcome back! I moved everything a bit to the left. Can you feel the difference?
Busy day! You, and a lizard. The lizard didn't buy anything.
There you are. The lamp bet me you'd never come back. The lamp owes me a bulb.
idle: Take your time. I've got loads. Found a whole box of it behind the generator.
Gerald's the till. He only talks when Scrap goes in. Bit like everybody.
Some nights I polish the chrome so the stars have something to look at.
Rule of the road: if it's ticking, hold it away from your face. Then ask questions.
I was out in May once. Worst storm of my life. Still finding sand in my pencil case.
Stuck on something? Turn it upside down. Works on jars. Works on most things. Not soup.
Most of what I know, I learned by breaking it first. Don't tell the customers.
Stand still long enough and the wind brings you stock. That's my whole supply chain.
buy: Sold! And a free key. Doesn't open anything I know of. Maybe something you know of.
Good choice. Great choice. Gerald, ring it up! ...He's thrilled. You can't tell.
Yours now! Have this button too. It came off something important.
Have a bolt for luck. Keep it in a pocket. Talk to it if things get bad out there.
Here, half a formula booklet, free. Somebody kept it like treasure. Pass it on.
Ooh, you'll love that. I loved it. Then I loved it less. You'll love it longer.
No refunds, no returns. Regrets are allowed, but you have to bring your own.
I wrapped it in a page of my memoirs. Don't read it. Well, you can. It's very long.
broke: Short on Scrap? Happens to the best of us. Happens to me hourly.
Not enough for that. Go have a run and bring me whatever falls off.
I'd give it to you, but Gerald's watching. He's very strict. He's a box.
Empty pockets are full pockets that haven't been out yet. I think. Go out.
Can't stretch to it today. Come back richer. Or come back the same and we'll chat.
No Scrap, no sale. Looking's free, though. Look as long as you like. Look harder.
capped: That's as good as it gets. I tried making it better once. It caught fire.
You've got all of it. There isn't any more. I checked the back. And the back of the back.
Maxed out! Any more and you'd rattle.
You've got the lot. Leave some for the lizard.
leave: Off you go! I don't say goodbye. Last time I said it, the roof left.
See you soon. Or soon-ish. Whichever comes first.
Mind the road. It's been in a mood since Tuesday.
Bring back stories. I pay well for a good one. Not in Scrap. In nodding.
Go on, then. The wasteland's lucky to have you. Don't tell it I said so.
